title: docs(source-twilio): fix incorrect links, dead URL, and changelog date
body:
## Documentation Confidence Assessment

**Overall Confidence: 4/5**

| Dimension | Score | Rationale |
|-----------|-------|-----------|
| Code Comprehension | 4/5 | Manifest-only YAML with simple custom components; all streams, auth, pagination, and error handling are declarative and readable. |
| API Documentation Quality | 5/5 | Comprehensive official Twilio API docs with auth guides, rate limit docs, changelogs, OpenAPI specs; metadata.yaml lists 6 external doc URLs. |
| Change Scope & Risk | 5/5 | Under 10 lines changed: changelog date correction, link fixes, dead URL replacement. |
| Existing Doc Maturity | 4/5 | Well-established 187-line doc with good coverage of prerequisites, setup, streams, performance, and changelog. |
| Connector Sensitivity | 3/5 | Certified connector with ql=200, sl=200; moderate usage. |
| Triggering Context | 5/5 | Triggered from a small, merged bug-fix PR (schema format correction). |

### What I Verified vs. What I Inferred

- **Verified from code**: All 34 streams in the manifest match the documented streams. The connector uses BasicHttpAuthenticator with Account SID and Auth Token. Rate limit handling uses `Retry-After` header with exponential backoff fallback (confirmed from manifest error_handler config). The `usage_records` stream uses `start_date` with `format: date` (the fix in the triggering commit).
- **Verified from API docs**: The Twilio Console at `console.twilio.com` is the current location for finding Account SID and Auth Token. The Calls API read endpoint anchor is `#read-multiple-call-resources`. The rate limit documentation is at `twilio.com/docs/usage/api#rate-limiting`. The old support article URL (`support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360044308153`) is dead.
- **Inferred**: Nothing was inferred; all changes are verifiable corrections.

### Areas of Concern

None identified. All changes are factual corrections to links and dates.

### Docusaurus Build

The local Docusaurus build could not be run because the transitive dependency `chevrotain@12.0.0` (via `mermaid` -> `langium`) requires Node >=22, but the build environment has Node 20.19.0. This is an environment limitation, not an issue with these changes.

---

## What

Fixes four issues in the Twilio source connector documentation:
1. **Incorrect Calls stream link**: Pointed to `#create-a-call-resource` instead of `#read-multiple-call-resources` — the connector reads calls, it doesn't create them.
2. **Dead rate limit URL**: The support article at `support.twilio.com` no longer exists; replaced with the official Twilio API rate limit documentation.
3. **Outdated Twilio dashboard link**: Updated from the old `twilio.com/user/account` URL to the current Twilio Console URL.
4. **Incorrect changelog date**: Version 0.17.9 was listed as 2026-04-29 but PR [#77593](https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte/pull/77593) was merged on 2026-04-30.

## How

- Corrected the Calls stream API link anchor from `#create-a-call-resource` to `#read-multiple-call-resources`
- Replaced the dead `support.twilio.com` rate limit article with `twilio.com/docs/usage/api#rate-limiting`
- Added detail that rate limiting uses the `Retry-After` header with exponential backoff fallback (verified from connector manifest)
- Updated the Twilio dashboard link to `console.twilio.com`
- Fixed changelog date for version 0.17.9 from 2026-04-29 to 2026-04-30

## Review guide

1. `docs/integrations/sources/twilio.md` — all changes are in this single file

## User Impact

Users following the documentation will now land on the correct Twilio API pages and Console URL. No functional connector changes.

## Can this PR be safely reverted and rolled back?

- [x] YES 💚

---

> **Note**: I am an AI assistant (Devin) and have proposed these documentation updates based on a review of the connector source code and third-party API documentation. Reviewers may merge, modify, or close this PR as they see fit.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/cb50291da6f244d39e415875ba15de5e
